title: LightThinker: Thinking step-by-step compression
reason: Segments CoT and compresses each step into special tokens with attention masks and KV-cache focus; survey reports 90.14% GSM8K and up to 1.4x latency speedup.

title: Deepscaler: Surpassing o1-preview with a 1.5B model by scaling RL
reason: Shows small-model reasoning can improve through RL, but the survey gives no token count and cites a Notion blog rather than an arXiv paper; model-size gain must not be treated as token compression.

title: φ-decoding: Adaptive foresight sampling for balanced inference-time exploration and exploitation
reason: Simulates future paths and clusters their distributions to choose each next step; survey reports 2.8x inference speedup and +6.14% accuracy, but this is decoding compute/latency rather than necessarily fewer final answer tokens.

title: Path-consistency: Prefix enhancement for efficient inference in LLM
reason: Reuses high-confidence prefixes across samples to accelerate self-consistency; survey reports +3.80% GSM8K and 1.2x latency speedup, with aggregate-sampling savings rather than a shorter CoT target.

title: When more is less: Understanding chain-of-thought length in LLMs
reason: Survey cites it as evidence that longer CoT can yield negative returns and accumulated errors; it is a necessary counterexample against equating more tokens with better reasoning.
